query: MATCH (n:V01)-[r:HAS_SOURCE]->(src) WHERE n.uid IN $externalUids AND n.useState='known' AND all(f IN ['useState','useValues','useScope'] WHERE f IN r.fields) AND r.sourceVersion=src.sourceVersion UNWIND n.useValues AS use RETURN use,collect(DISTINCT n.uid) AS spaceUids,count(DISTINCT n.uid) AS spaceCount ORDER BY use
